verdict.rationale: Render is a cloud application platform, so managed global AI inference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows no documented serverless or GPU inference offering and no single-call global model execution. Adjacent items do not deliver the story: the global CDN serves static assets only, and managed OIDC only authenticates services to external providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning
